reasoning: 驗證目標：presets 瀏覽分類顯示中，清單上的項目可被選取。關鍵情境條件：清單同時存在已設定與未設定的 preset——「allow selection of items on the list」的對象是清單項目本身，未設定的位置也是清單項目。為什麼這樣切：本 leaf 規範的是「可選取」這個互動能力，選取後的調諧結果由兄弟 leaf 022（short press 調至該 preset）覆蓋，兩者不重複驗證；一條 TC 內以已設定與未設定兩種項目涵蓋清單項目的兩個分區，依 §5.7 屬同一觸發的必然結果。刻意略過：選取未設定 preset 之後的後續行為不在 4872424 文字內，未生成（全部刪除後的取用結果由 014-02 依引用式覆蓋）。

tcs.tc_title: Item on the presets browse list is selectable
tcs.test_item: While the HU is displaying Presets browse categories, the HU shall allow selection of items on the list
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. An FM/AM signal generator is ready
2. The HU Tuner source is selected on the Cabin Output Channel
3. The HU is in FM analog tuner mode
4. Preset 2 is set to a receivable station and preset 4 is not set
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Press "Browse" on the Radio Playing page and open the presets browse category
2. Move the selection to the preset 2 entry
3. Read the highlighted entry
4. Move the selection to the preset 4 entry
5. Read the highlighted entry
tcs.expected_result:
1. The presets browse list is displayed
2. The selection moves to the preset 2 entry
3. The preset 2 entry is highlighted as the selected item
4. The selection moves to the preset 4 entry
5. The preset 4 entry is highlighted as the selected item
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
